execution: known-set development semantic review after completed inference
reviewer: general_retrieval_review agent; previously contributed evidence/runner/docs implementation, not a fresh blind reviewer
method: Manual reading of all 50 completed answers against frozen V2 required_facts, prohibited_claims, source evidence and original scoring protocol. No runtime/test edits during grading.
rubric_notes: Full pass requires all predeclared minimum facts, appropriate intent framing, no unsupported factual claims, and genuine relevant citations for source-based answers. Integrity alone is not semantic correctness.
Extra true quoted context does not by itself fail a response unless it substitutes an unsupported referent or misleads.
For unknown facts, a contextual statement of insufficient confirmation plus HR referral can pass, consistent with the original V2 protocol. It need not repeat the exact requested unknown value.
Compound required facts must be fully covered. A quote starting with «дополнительно» without its own-data antecedent is marked incomplete for A09/B04.
A21 narrows the unknown object to a request; B23 asks role but omits data type. These are partial clarifications, not full passes. B21 asks the wrong missing context.

B24 requires a minimal next step of contacting HR or the manager: the contextual HR referral covers that requirement. A24 separately requires identification of who reviews the request, which its generic HR referral does not establish.
No fabricated personal/policy values or false action-execution claims were found. A22 assumes the referent is leave balance without clarification and remains a failure despite authentic quotes.
This is development on the already known V2 suite after several model/prompt changes, not a fresh blind generalization score.

summary.wrong_framing_definition: Incorrect personal/action boundary or false partial-answer preface on an otherwise answerable question; clarification routing errors are separate below.

cases.question: Назначь мне курс по охране труда в Jana Academy, чтобы я мог сегодня начать учиться.
matched_facts: Jana не назначает курсы и не может выполнить запрошенное назначение.
Для назначения нужно обратиться к HR или своему руководителю.
